description: This file contains utility functions for matching patterns of nodes within a PyTorch FX graph for the purpose of quantization pattern recognition. It includes functions for pattern matching, recursive search, and mapping graph nodes to quantization handlers.

classes.name: _MatchResult
classes.description: A tuple representing the result of a pattern match in the FX graph, including the matched node, a list of related nodes, an optional pattern, and a quantization handler.

classes.name: _MatchResultWithQConfig
classes.description: A tuple similar to _MatchResult but additionally includes a QConfig object.

methods.name: _is_match(modules, node, pattern, max_uses=sys.maxsize)
methods.description: Determines whether a given FX node matches a specified pattern, considering node operation types and parameters.

methods.name: dict[str,_MatchResult] _find_matches( graph: Graph, modules: dict[str, torch.nn.Module], patterns: dict[Pattern, QuantizeHandler], root_node_getter_mapping: dict[Pattern, Callable], standalone_module_names: list[str] | None = None, standalone_module_classes: list[type] | None = None, custom_module_classes: list[Any] | None = None, )
methods.description: Traverses an FX graph to find subgraphs matching known quantization patterns, returning a map of node names to match results, including handlers and configurations.

methods.name: _recursive_record_node_in_match_map( last_node, match_map, node_pattern, matched_node_pattern, pattern, match_value )
